dedupe_keys.name: sandia quest energy storage analysis suite

description: QuESt is Sandia National Laboratories' software suite for energy-storage analysis. Its application hub includes data management, market valuation, behind-the-meter tariff analysis, technology selection, performance and microgrid planning tools. Users configure storage assets, operating assumptions and the input data required by each application, then compare schedules, costs or performance results. Coverage is globally configurable, although named market-analysis applications use particular electricity-market rules; time resolution follows the selected application. Public source and installation instructions are free under the BSD 3-Clause licence read from the repository's licence endpoint. A limitation is that applications have separate dependencies and modelling scopes, so results are not interchangeable across markets or technologies. Optional language-model integrations may require external services under their own terms. Installation guides also distinguish operating systems and legacy Apple Silicon arrangements. QuESt supports storage investment and operational scenario studies, complementary to PyPSA (model-pypsa). The README lists research applications, but no market result or claimed saving was reproduced here.
name: Sandia QuESt energy-storage analysis suite
